{{Quote|Well, officers' mess rules say you shouldn't use the Force until after the Bespin port is served but we're very relaxed here.|[[Corr]], in response to [[Bardan Jusik]]|<ref name="Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref>}}
'''Bespin port''' was one of the finest [[Port (alcohol)|ports]] produced in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It was native to [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]], and had a sweet taste to it. It was made with [[Tatooinian Berry Fruit]], [[Tatooinian Fruit]], and [[Tatooinian Vegetable Tuber]]s.<ref name="SWG" />
